deploy.startCommand: CLINIC_COUNT=$(php artisan tinker --execute="echo App\Models\Clinic::count();" 2>/dev/null || echo "0") && if [ "$CLINIC_COUNT" -lt "30" ]; then echo "Running database seeders (found $CLINIC_COUNT clinics, need at least 30)..." && php artisan db:seed --force && echo "✅ Database seeders completed"; else echo "✅ Database already seeded ($CLINIC_COUNT clinics found)"; fi && mkdir -p storage/app/public/clinic-gallery storage/app/public/clinic-logos storage/app/public/clinics storage/app/public/clinics/treatments storage/app/public/user-avatars && rm -rf public/storage && php artisan storage:link && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT
